coder_notes: Basket trial of MTAP-loss solid tumours with dedicated GBM single-agent and combination expansion cohorts. TNG456 is the only investigational agent in the single-agent arms (rule 4 applied first -> experimental_monotherapy) and is also given with abemaciclib in combination arms; abemaciclib appears only in combination arms with TNG456, so experimental_combination. Regimen coded combination because combination arms exist; the trial also has single-agent TNG456 arms (mixed design). MTAP loss + PRMT5 inhibitor is the manual's example of candidate matching. CDKN2A not mentioned. cns5: requires IDH-wildtype (conditions also say 'Glioblastoma Multiforme'). Eli Lilly (abemaciclib maker) is a collaborator, but no text states drug supply.
